subject: zoology
question_text: What is the importance of air bladder in fishes?

verification.note: Sourced from the Sri Chaitanya Junior Fastrack zoology section (book p.55, VSAQ 111). Zoology holds only ONE source book — the TSBIE Basic Learning Material in hand covers physics only, and no zoology board paper is in the corpus — so the two-book union check and the back-test are both structurally impossible for this card; 'not checked' does NOT mean 'checked and clean'. The mark split is a claim until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it. TEXT BEYOND THE BOOK: the book gives three uses (hydrostatic organ, vertical movement, respiration in some); the sound use is added from the standard syllabus account.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Hydrostatic organ
steps.margin_note: State that it is a hydrostatic organ and say what that means. Two or three lines.
lines: The air bladder is a gas filled sac present in
It acts as a hydrostatic organ. The gas in it
changes the density of the fish, so the fish
floats at the depth it needs without swimming.
steps.why: The air bladder works by changing density, and every use of it follows from that one idea, so the density line is written first.
common_mistakes: Writing that the air bladder is a lung. It is a hydrostatic organ in most bony fishes.
Giving the air bladder to sharks. Cartilaginous fishes have no air bladder.
steps.memory_tip: Gas in, density down, fish rises. The air bladder is a float, not a lung.

steps.label: Other uses
steps.margin_note: Name the extra uses in a list. One line each is enough.

lines.text: Hydrostatic organ: up and down, respiration

lines: It helps the fish move up and down in the
In some fishes it also helps in respiration.
In some fishes it helps in producing and
steps.why: The second mark is for the extra uses, and they are easiest to remember as a short list in the order float, move, breathe.
common_mistakes: Giving only the floating use. Two marks need at least two uses.
Writing that all fishes have an air bladder. Cartilaginous fishes do not.
steps.memory_tip: Float, move up and down, breathe in a few: three uses in that order.

insider_note: The word hydrostatic is the marked word; an answer that only says the fish floats usually loses half the credit.
